- memory_id "1000841": The Boreal team observed on 2025-11-03 that the notification service's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift.  (about: Boreal team, notification service, traffic shift)

- memory_id "1000746": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service no longer relies on the ledger service; it uses the bus as its source.  (about: ledger service, the bus, reporting service)

- memory_id "1000727" [constraint]: As of 2025-09-23, the Boreal team says to page Lena for anything this cycle, not Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000610": Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle as of 2025-07-30.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000541": Lena has the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-06-27, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000533" [decision]: The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000480": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000446": Lena is the release captain for Q1 2026.  (about: Lena)
- memory_id "1000430": As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000424": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, when ownership moved from the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000420": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000395": The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000057": The Boreal team looks after the bus.  (about: Boreal team, the bus)
- memory_id "1000011": The Boreal team consists of Lena and Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
